verdict.summary: The change is internally consistent and fail-closed as scoped. P-384 dispatch resolves the curve profile before selecting SHA-384, uses the matching RustCrypto verifier, and is pinned by both published W3C vectors and negative cross-profile/tamper tests. The JSON-LD envelope removes proofValue, copies the document context onto the proof configuration, restricts remote context loading to the caller-provided map, rejects named graphs and proof arrays, and delegates to the existing RDF-native verifier. Public API documentation and the relevant ZK design/audit posture remain explicit that this is off-circuit, caller-keyed, not externally audited, and does not establish an in-circuit property. No hostile reviewer-directed instruction was found in the diff.
